verdict.rationale: Qapita's own materials describe cap table and compliance reporting tools built for legal teams handling client equity. That suggests law firms can work inside the platform, but it is a single one-line claim with no detail on how counsel access or collaboration works. Missing for 10: documented law-firm or outside-counsel user roles and permissions, in-platform document preparation by counsel, counsel-driven record updates replacing spreadsheet exchange, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
